caption: The drawing depicts a single ornate chair positioned slightly at an angle. The chair features a plush, round backrest and an oval seat, both upholstered in a rose-pink fabric with subtle decorative patterns. The frame of the chair, including the legs, back, and support, is made of dark brown wood with intricate, scrolling carvings, especially along the backrest and the apron beneath the seat. The chair stands on four cabriole-style legs, each ending in a small caster wheel. The background is a plain, light beige color with no additional objects or decorations. There is a small signature with the text "B Gussow" in the bottom left corner.
title: Side Chair (one of four)
